_om: Fortelleren in English (Chinwag, rusj.no/en/chinwag/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. «Spør videre» is the follow-up idea on each card («Ask more»); «Barn og voksen» is a child and a grown-up playing together («Begge svarer»: both answer the same card). The cards are in data.en/kort.json, written for the UK.
Et barn og en voksen – begge svarer: A child and a grown-up – both answer
Store og små rundt bordet: Big and small round the table
Bli enda bedre kjent: Get to know each other even better
Samme kort til barnet og den voksne: The same card for the child and the grown-up
Én svarer, de andre spør videre: One answers, the others ask more
Gjett først – så kommer svaret: Guess first – then hear the answer
Det samme – svar du også!: The same one – you answer too!
Spør videre med «Fortell mer!», «Hvordan: Follow up with ‘Tell me more!’, ‘What was that like?’ or ‘What happened next?’.
Si det barnet sa med dine egne ord: «Så: Say back what the child said in your own words: ‘So that made you happy?’ It shows you’re really listening.
Ingen svar er feil. Ikke rett på svaret: There are no wrong answers. Don’t correct and don’t give advice – just be curious.
Svar selv også, gjerne først. Det gjør d: Answer too – first, if you like. It makes sharing feel safer.
If someone doesn’t want to answer, that’s fine. Don’t dig – come back to it another time.
Trekk et kort og fortell. De andre lytte: Draw a card and tell your story. The others listen and ask more. There are no wrong answers – and you can always pass.
Barn og voksen, familie, venner, ungdom: A child and a grown-up, family, friends, teens or adults. For children you pick an age – the youngest get short questions with pictures for a grown-up to read aloud.
Den som har tur, svarer på kortet. De an: Whoever’s turn it is answers the card. The others listen and ask more – there’s an idea at the bottom of the card.
I «Gjett svaret» gjetter de andre først: In ‘Guess the answer’ the others guess first what the answer will be. In ‘Both answer’ the child and the grown-up answer the same card.
Lytt mer enn du snakker. «Fortell mer!»: Listen more than you talk. ‘Tell me more!’ is often the best question.
Vil du ikke svare? Trykk «Stå over» elle: Don’t want to answer? Tap ‘Pass’ or ‘New card’ – that’s always fine. You can also swipe the card away.
Velg nivået «Stiger», så begynner det le: Choose the ‘Rising’ level: it starts light and goes a little deeper as you play.
Trykk på hjertet for å lagre et kort der: Tap the heart to save a card you liked. Favourites are kept on this phone only.
Tell, listen and get to know each other.
Begynner lett og blir litt dypere etter: Starts light and goes a little deeper as you play.
A bit more to think about.
Feelings, dreams and the things that matter.
A little while – lovely at bedtime.
Plenty of time – for long evenings.
Korte spørsmål med bilder. Den voksne le: Short questions with pictures. The grown-up reads aloud.
Imagination, friends, school and everyday life.
Litt større tanker om venner, rettferdig: Bigger thoughts about friends, fairness and the future.
Ett poeng for hvert treff. Helt frivilli: A point for every right guess. Totally optional.
Thanks for listening to each other.
Dere kan alltid trekke flere kort en ann: You can always draw more cards another time.
Ingen treff denne gangen – nå vet dere m: No right guesses this time – but now you know more!
Kortene dere har lagret med hjertet. De: The cards you’ve saved with the heart. They’re kept on this phone only.
Ingen favoritter ennå. Trykk på hjertet: No favourites yet. Tap the heart under a card to save it.
Finish the game you’re playing first.
Your favourites list is full. Remove some first.
Ingen av favorittene passer i «Gjett sva: None of your favourites work in ‘Guess the answer’. Choose another way to play.
Dere ser hvor mange kort dere har snakke: You’ll see how many cards you talked about. Your favourites stay saved.
